items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Freddie Martin was there that early, wasn't he? [INTERVIEWEE] He was -- I think the Ambassador, I think he was a little later than some of these others. Freddie

ctx.x: Well, they changed from time to time, and I remember Gus Arnheim and oh, many different bands that played these hotels and spots around town, Cinderella Roof, and oh, lots of places, too numerous to mention, because there were -- that was way back.
Freddie Martin was there that early, wasn't he?
He was -- I think the Ambassador, I think he was a little later than some of these others. Freddie
